chunks: This book was completed in the month of Rajab, in the year 400 A.H.

key_terms.رَجَبَ: Rajab (the seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar)

ai.summary: This colophon marks the completion of Sharif al-Radi's compilation in Rajab 400 AH, a period when the Buyid dynasty provided crucial political stability for the flourishing of Twelver Shia scholarship in Baghdad. The date anchors the text within the 'Golden Age' of Shia intellectual history, reflecting the compiler's effort to preserve the Prophet's and Imams' teachings amidst evolving theological and political landscapes.
